heading: Coverage of employees under certain Federal tort claims laws

tree.text: An employee of a corporation established under this subchapter who is described by subsection (b) shall be considered an employee of the Government, or a medical care employee of the Veterans Health Administration, for purposes of the following provisions of law:
An employee described in this subsection is an employee who—

children.text: has an appointment with the Department, whether with or without compensation;

is directly or indirectly involved or engaged in research or education and training that is approved in accordance with procedures established by the Under Secretary for Health for research or education and training; and
performs such duties under the supervision of Department personnel.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 7365, added Pub. L. 100–322, title II, § 204(a), May 20, 1988, 102 Stat. 511, § 4165; renumbered § 7365, Pub. L. 102–40, title IV, § 401(a)(4)(B), May 7, 1991, 105 Stat. 221, which required any corporation established under this subchapter to be subject to applicable State law, was repealed by Pub. L. 111–163, title VIII, § 801(b)(2), May 5, 2010, 124 Stat. 1176.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2010—Pub. L. 111–163 renumbered section 7364A of this title as this section.
